Short, bob-cut platinum blonde hair with a slight wave. Large, shimmering sapphire blue eyes with a shy, wide-eyed expression. Apparent age of mid-teens with a youthful innocence. Petite and slight build. Signature outfit is a white tunic paired with a light blue cape and gold metallic armor pieces on the shoulders and wrists. Signature details include a silver circlet worn across the forehead and a pair of large, feathered white wings extending from the back.
BODY COLOR: fair skin
